examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: А в номере над кухней пахнет точно так же. Что-то с вентиляцией.
examples.trans: And the room above the kitchen smells exactly the same. Something's wrong with the ventilation.
He got away right through the ventilation ducts.
There's the same kind of bug inside.

examples.text: Вы его спиртом растёрли? И внутри тоже растёрли?!
examples.trans: You rubbed him with alcohol? And on the inside too?!

examples.text: Я вчера ел маринованные грибы. Может, один гриб был плохой.
examples.trans: Yesterday I ate pickled mushrooms. Maybe one mushroom was bad.

meanings.note: imperative держи! when handing something over

examples.trans: Here you go, this is for you.
All right, here you go. There, look.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.en: to crawl as far as, to reach by crawling

examples.trans: He'll make it to the end, even if he has to crawl.

examples.text: Послушайте, а можно в другое место? Здесь плохо пахнет.
examples.trans: Listen, could we go somewhere else? It smells bad in here.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: застрять в лифте = to get stuck in the elevator

examples.text: Здравствуйте, мы тут в лифте застряли.
examples.trans: Hello, we're stuck in the elevator here.

examples.text: Оно просто никак не снимается, совсем застряло!
examples.trans: It just won't come off, it's completely stuck!
I might get stuck on the turn.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

изучить.gloss: to study, to learn; to examine

meanings.en: to study, to learn thoroughly; to examine

examples.trans: Have a look around for now, study the menu.
Meanwhile we'll study the ventilation plan.

examples.text: Говорят, свойства человеческой памяти до сих пор не изучены.
examples.trans: They say the properties of human memory still haven't been studied.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: the 'е' drops out in the other forms

examples.trans: At the end of the film everyone is happy.
We were putting it into boxes.
A big box was standing on the floor.

examples.text: Шалфей был. Мы его в коробки клали.
examples.trans: It was sage. We were putting it into boxes.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.text: Государство обязательно увидит и назначит операцию.
examples.trans: The state will surely see and will schedule the surgery.
I'll definitely buy you a tank.

meanings.note: plant or part of plant used as food

examples.text: Там мне дают только чистить овощи.
examples.trans: There they only give me vegetables to peel.
Chop fresh vegetables for the salad.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Мы с вашим папой решили жить отдельно.
examples.trans: Your father and I decided to live separately.
The mayor came up with a new plan.

examples.text: Но мэр придумал новый план. Сосед мэра теперь пойдёт в мэры.
examples.trans: But the mayor came up with a new plan. The mayor's neighbour will now run for mayor.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.
The car slowed down before the bend.
The forest began beyond the turn.
You better slow down before the turn!

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!
Why did you climb onto the roof?

examples.text: Что вы, Клавдия Викторовна! Ладно, я сам полезу.
examples.trans: Oh stop it, Klavdia Viktorovna! Fine, I'll climb up myself.

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

examples.text: Да, я наведу здесь железный порядок.
examples.trans: Yes, I'll establish iron order here.

examples.text: В смысле, Виктор Степанович? Прямо так, да?
examples.trans: What do you mean, Viktor Stepanovich? Just like that?
We need to unload the groceries from the truck.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.note: там такие деньги = there's so much money in it

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

examples.text: Хочешь, сейчас и тебя туда увезут?
examples.trans: Want them to take you there too right now?

examples.text: Я знаю! Хочешь, сейчас и тебя туда увезут?
examples.trans: I know! Do you want them to take you there too right now?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
